summary_en: This study tests AZD9574, a drug taken by mouth, alone and combined with other anti-cancer drugs, in people with advanced solid cancers that have come back or grown. AZD9574 is taken by mouth, temozolomide is taken by mouth, and trastuzumab deruxtecan and datopotamab deruxtecan are given into a vein, and how often and for how long these are given is not stated. This is a Phase 1/Phase 2 study that aims to measure safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and preliminary efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa AZD9574, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, solo y combinado con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en personas con cánceres sólidos avanzados que han reaparecido o progresado. AZD9574 se toma por vía oral, la temozolomida también se toma por vía oral, y el trastuzumab deruxtecan y el datopotamab deruxtecan se administran por vía intravenosa; la frecuencia y la duración de estos tratamientos no se indican. Es un estudio de Fase 1/Fase 2 que busca medir la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la eficacia preliminar.
who_for: Progressive cancer at enrollment, with ECOG performance status not worse over the previous 2 weeks.
Certain advanced ovarian, breast, prostate or pancreatic cancers with a predicted loss-of-function change in BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, RAD51C or RAD51D.
IDH1/2-mutant glioma that is suitable for temozolomide, progressed after radiation and one prior alkylating chemotherapy.
Some modules require HER2-positive, HER2-low or HER2-ultralow advanced cancer, depending on the cohort.
